Last night, the Senate passed my May as Stroke Awareness Month Resolution. 

At 49, I thought I was the last person at risk for having a stroke. Knowing the early symptoms saved my life. 
https://t.co/hnQvPglBgF

Thank you @POTUS for announcing a pay increase, new mental wellness and health supports, and a new wildland fire management job series for federal firefighters. This means so much to our firefighters back home in NM who’ve been giving life and limb to keep us safe.

I'm outraged by UAE's decision to detain Asim Ghafoor, a U.S. citizen and lawyer for Jamal Kashoggi. I join the calls urging the UAE to provide Ghafoor with humane treatment and an adequate legal representation.

So grateful that my friend @ChrisVanHollen and I took the early warning signs of having a stroke seriously and got to the hospital. Learn the early symptoms of strokes and make sure you’re taking time for yourself everyday. It can save your life. https://t.co/OpI7t0NOot

Wonderful to see @UNM SRMC launch their peer-to-peer treatment for people struggling with substance use disorders using federal funding I helped secure. This is going to help many NMs with substance use disorders & put them on a pathway to recovery.
https://t.co/C16HFOM0me

I’m proud to join @SenWhitehouse and @SenAmyKlobuchar in introducing the Improving Treatment for Pregnant and Postpartum Women Act 2.0 that’ll support families and children in all communities to prevent health risks and help treat substance use disorders.

Veterans who struggle with mental health & thoughts of suicide shouldn't worry about the cost of seeking treatment.

Emergency mental health care for vets will now be free through @DeptVetAffairs because it's the right thing to do.

Don't wait to get help, talk to someone today.

I have the honor and privilege of being a part of a new community. A community of doctors, nurses, researchers, scientists, and survivors who are all working towards the prevention and treatment of stroke. Thank you for having me, @AHAScience. #ISC23 https://t.co/ybkS1KEMlc

Yesterday, I had the honor of being welcomed back to the Roundhouse to address a joint session. Of the many things I touched on, I really want to hit home the importance of brain health. Learn the symptoms of stroke. It can save your life, or a loved one.
https://t.co/85umE4y5lZ

We can’t be afraid to have honest conversations about mental health.

I was grateful to host a mental health roundtable last night with first responders, veterans, and New Mexican leaders on mental health awareness, treatment, and solutions. https://t.co/rZ5dss4GS7
I am sending heartfelt prayers to the families of the 9 Army Soldiers who lost their lives in the training exercise in Kentucky. We stand with you during this difficult time.

This week is the beginning of Stroke Awareness Month. For all of May, I’m going to be sharing personal stories, educational materials and the work that I’ve been doing for the prevention and treatment of strokes.
Learning the early symptoms of having a stroke can save your life or the life of a loved one. Remember to BEFAST! https://t.co/X1qCFsFEkH

Our country and our state was built on the backs of immigrants.

Immigrant communities impact us all for the better. During Immigrant Heritage Month and every month, I'm committed to not just celebrating immigrants, but to fighting for equitable treatment under the law.

Learn the early symptoms of having a stroke, it can save your life or the life of a loved one. Not a day goes by without feeling grateful for the people around me who urged me to seek immediate medical attention when my symptoms started. Learn them now. https://t.co/IkLMwCAM8z

Just in its 1st year alone, the 988 Lifeline has been a life-saving resource to millions, and over 39K NMs.

Investments in mental health resources are vital to public health and safety. It’s on Congress to expand mental health services & wellness to all.
https://t.co/SaW5sjrxno

As negotiations for the Farm Bill continue, and as a member of @SenateAgDems, I’m fighting to include expansive nutrition legislation.

My 6 bills are dedicated to increasing nutrition access, protecting local grocers, and closing loopholes.

No one should go hungry and each of these bills will help people get fed.
🌽 Tribal Nutrition Flexibility Act
🍎 Tribal Nutrition Program Administration Act
🫛 The Nutrition Administration Assistance Act

USDA's latest report is deeply alarming. It's critical that federal nutrition programs like WIC and SNAP have the resources needed to reach hungry families.

That's why I introduced a package of 6 nutrition bills to keep food on the table.
https://t.co/1ahDcBqTLs

Congress cannot lose sight of prioritizing food assistance in this year’s Farm Bill.
 
Despite Republican pushback, I’m fighting to ensure life-saving nutrition assistance programs like SNAP get the funding they need to keep food on the table. Ending hunger should be bipartisan.

I was grateful to speak with so many doctors and professionals in neurology, individuals dedicated to stroke prevention and treatment – a cause close to my heart. 
 
Thank you, @AANmember, for the opportunity to share a few words.

This legislation also funds protections for nutrition access for women and their babies, supports our Ag industry, increases affordable housing, & delivers investments in public safety. I’m proud of our efforts in this first bill & looking forward to see them make things better.
Over 160 years ago before Arizona was even a state, a law was passed that made it illegal for women to exercise the right to make her own medical decisions – regardless of the situation.

Our many cultures and traditions are what make us strong.

I'm disappointed by the treatment this young graduate received and I hope everyone will learn to make things better for future students.

Genesis — congratulations on this achievement. Your graduation cap was brilliant!

Domestic workers are the backbone of communities and deserve to be treated with respect and dignity.

I’m proud to introduce the Domestic Workers Bill of Rights Act with @SenGillibrand, @RepJayapal, and @domesticworkers requiring fair treatment for all domestic workers.
